headline: IndusInd Bank Shares Gain 1.2% After Partnering with Mastercard
summary: Shares of IndusInd Bank gained 1.2% following the launch of a new cross-border payment partnership with Mastercard to enable seamless consumer overseas transfers.
why: Partnering with global payment networks expands private Indian lenders' fee income in lucrative overseas remittance and retail cross-border settlement channels.

impacts.name: IndusInd Bank
impacts.why: IndusInd Bank shares rose 1.2% after announcing an international payments partnership with Mastercard.
